best_match.fbbt_term: antennal lobe projection neuron of ALl1 lineage
best_match.fbbt_definition: Renamed from lPN as this now implies dorsal hemilineage (Bates et al., 2020). Antennal lobe projection neuron that derives from the lateral antennal lobe neuroblast.

justification: Up to the pupal stage the immature term is used (curator), but FBbt has no immature (or remodelling) antennal lobe projection neuron terms yet (requested, curator 2026-10-17); meanwhile the stage-neutral class for the authors' lineage (lPN), to be refined when the new terms exist. Lineage from the paper's definitions: DA1 and DL3 PNs are acj6- lPNs (Mz19+/acj6- DA1; the acj6-/CG31676+ clusters #6 / #6' DL3), VA1d, DC3, DC2 and VM2 acj6+ adPNs (Figures 3-4).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00067362 antennal lobe projection neuron of ALl1 lineage (broad match) until FBbt has the immature / remodelling term for DL3.
